command: set -euo pipefail; echo '--- ARCHITECTURE_GREP ---'; failures=0; if grep -R --include='*.kt' -nE '^import android\.' core/domain/src 2>/dev/null | head -n 20 | grep .; then echo CORE_DOMAIN_ANDROID_IMPORTS_FOUND; failures=$((failures+1)); else echo CORE_DOMAIN_ANDROID_IMPORTS_NONE; fi; if grep -R --include='*.kt' -n 'io.blueeye.core.data' feature 2>/dev/null | head -n 20 | grep .; then echo FEATURE_CORE_DATA_IMPORTS_FOUND; failures=$((failures+1)); else echo FEATURE_CORE_DATA_IMPORTS_NONE; fi; if grep -R --include='*.kt' -nE 'Color\(0xFF|R\.color\.' feature 2>/dev/null | head -n 20 | grep .; then echo FEATURE_RAW_COLOR_FOUND; failures=$((failures+1)); else echo FEATURE_RAW_COLOR_NONE; fi; XML_LAYOUTS=$(find . -path '*/src/main/res/layout/*.xml' -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo XML_LAYOUT_COUNT=$XML_LAYOUTS; LEGACY=$(grep -R --include='*.kt' -nE 'FragmentManager|AsyncTask|LiveData|io\.reactivex|rxjava' app core feature 2>/dev/null | head -n 30 || true); if [ -n "$LEGACY" ]; then echo "$LEGACY"; echo LEGACY_API_REFERENCES_FOUND; failures=$((failures+1)); else echo LEGACY_API_REFERENCES_NONE; fi; test "$failures" -eq 0; echo ARCHITECTURE_GREP_PASS
